          theorem LargeIndecomposable.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.indecomposableMultiplicity_eq_of_fintype_decomposition {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] [IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ] (S : FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton k A) (p : Fin S.n) (M : FinitelyGeneratedCategory A) {I : Type} [Fintype I] [Finite I] {label : I → Fin S.n} (d : M ≅ ⨁ fun (i : I) => S.fgObj (label i)) :

          The fixed multiplicity agrees with a decomposition indexed by any finite type. This is the index-neutral form used by almost-split decompositions, whose index is stored as a FintypeCat.
